dedupe_keys.name: desert underwater network simulation and emulation

description: DESERT Underwater is a C++ library collection developed by the SIGNET laboratory at the University of Padova for underwater communication networks. It extends NS-Miracle with protocol-stack modules and additional packers that connect simulations to real devices. Users configure network protocols, nodes and scenarios; outputs support protocol behaviour analysis in simulation and, with suitable equipment, emulated or sea-test operation. Coverage is globally configurable for underwater network layouts and experiment durations. Public source and installation documentation are free under BSD-3-Clause-style terms; the inspected licence retains an unfilled organisation placeholder in its non-endorsement clause. A limitation is dependence on NS-Miracle and appropriate device interfaces, so source availability alone does not establish compatibility with particular underwater hardware. The library can simulate subsea monitoring and communication infrastructure, complementary to the general ns-3 platform (platform-ns-3). Its README links detailed Doxygen documentation, installation steps and sample scenarios. No protocol stack was installed, hardware connected or experimental dataset downloaded.
